title: Construction of the miRNA/Pyroptosis-Related Molecular Regulatory Axis in Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm: Evidence From Transcriptome Data Combined With Multiple Machine Learning Approaches Followed by Experiment Validation.
summary: The primary full text's Methods and Results support the assigned case-specific AI-enabled result: ML-derived aneurysm markers were assessed across patient datasets and expression was validated experimentally in vascular samples.
